name: csv_holdings_with_cost
query: SELECT account, units(sum(position)) AS units, cost(sum(position)) AS book WHERE account ~ '^Assets:US:ETrade:' AND account != 'Assets:US:ETrade:Cash' GROUP BY account ORDER BY account
notes: Four commodities with one row each tie on the count, so they are ordered by name descending: VHT, VEA, ITOT, GLD.
